text:
maria: Found a plaintext GCP service-account JSON embedded in a partner ConfigMap in partner-staging. Not prod, but still actionable.
aj: where exactly?
maria: `namespace=partner-staging`, `configmap=partner-ingest-config`, field `GCP_SA_KEY` (base64). Pulled via `kubectl get cm -n partner-staging partner-ingest-config -o yaml`.
kevin: is it a long-lived JSON key or a short-lived token?
maria: full JSON key (private_key present). Looks old.
sophie: escalate to rotation. Who has permissions to revoke?
aj: I can delete the key once we have client_email. Maria, paste client_email only.
maria: client_email: partner-ingest@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
kevin: that is the onboarding SA. Plan: 1) revoke key in GCP 2) delete key from CM 3) migrate partner CI to Workload Identity 4) audit cluster for similar fields and push admission control.
ryan-oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-348 severity=medium. PagerDuty notified.
aj: running revoke: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-ingest@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format=json | jq '.[].name'` then `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY --iam-account=...`
sec-eng-bot: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/credential-leak-cleanup 
maria: revoke confirmed. GCP returned: "Deleted key." 
maria: patched the ConfigMap to remove `GCP_SA_KEY`: `kubectl patch cm partner-ingest-config -n partner-staging --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/data/GCP_SA_KEY"}]'` then created a k8s Secret pointing to the partner CI workload token. Annotated resource: `secrets/rotated-by=eng-security`.
sophie: next steps: - partner comms (I will own) - admission controller to block base64 JSON in configmaps - audit alerts on `iam.serviceAccounts.keys.*` - cluster-wide grep for `client_email:` and `private_key` patterns.
kevin: I'll add a ticket for the admission controller and an eval job to run the grep across clusters and S3 snapshots. Also check backups for any stored ciphertext; run KMS key rewrap checks.
aj: partner repo contains a script writing the key. We'll ask them to remove and adopt Workload Identity. Sophie pls lead the comms.
sophie: will draft and send; scheduling 30-min sync with partner.
maria: exporting k8s audit slice for partner-staging last 30d to GCS for forensics.
kevin: file postmortem + RCA, update onboarding docs to forbid static SA keys in CI.
aj: updating incident INC-2026-348 with actions taken.
sophie: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
